notes.title: Jiangshi x Daoshi - Episode III: Lady Hexers Is Out!
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1360370/Jiangshi_x_Daoshi_Episode_III__Lady_Hexers/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4220499/28161b72a4f6515e72b4647c6e86d02f86d40409.png[/img][/url]
It’s time to get charmed! 

The third episode of Dendo-Denkido’s epic adventure visual novel Jiangshi x Daoshi: Laxy Hexers has just been released! 

Jiangshi x Daoshi Episode III - Lady Hexers continues the marvelous adventures of ex-assassin Luan and dao master Ling Ling!

Alongside Episode III’s release, the full game has been updated to support Simplified and Traditional Chinese in addition to English and Japanese.
